scenes.title: Кто главный в ресторане  (Who Runs the Restaurant)
scenes.summary: At the bar counter, Max and Kostya debate who truly runs the restaurant, concluding that guests hold ultimate authority despite all their quirks and demands.

scenes.title: Тайный критик  (The Secret Critic)
scenes.summary: Restaurant administrator Victoria gathers the kitchen brigade to announce that an anonymous international food critic is dining at Claude Monet today, ordering Barinov to keep novice cook Max off the line.

scenes.title: Свидание на митинге  (A Date at the Rally)
scenes.summary: Bartender Kostya asks waitress Nastya out on a romantic weekend date, only to be surprised when she eagerly invites him to an environmental protest rally in the Khimki forest.

scenes.title: Возвращение на кухню  (Return to the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov catches Max slacking off after Victoria suspended him, angrily overrules her decision, and orders Max back to the kitchen line.

scenes.title: В поисках критика  (In Search of the Critic)
scenes.summary: Observing the dining room from the bar, Kostya and Max scrutinize the guests and their food orders to identify the undercover restaurant critic.

scenes.title: Отказ от салата  (The Rejected Salad)
scenes.summary: Kostya rushes into the kitchen to alert Chef Barinov that a demanding guest at table seven rejected her salad, suspecting she is the food critic.

scenes.title: Отказ от салата  (Salad Rejection)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Victoria confronts Chef Barinov after a guest rejects Max's salad, and Barinov orders Max to urgently remake the dish himself.

scenes.title: Потерянный телефон  (The Lost Phone)
scenes.summary: At the Claude Monet bar counter, an exhausted and hungover visitor recovers his lost phone from Kostya and shares his troubles about his girlfriend.

scenes.title: Средство от похмелья  (A Cure for a Hangover)
scenes.summary: The guest explains to Kostya why his girlfriend dumped him for refusing to skydive, and Chef Barinov recommends a hot bouillabaisse as the perfect remedy.

scenes.title: Подозрительная гостья  (A Suspicious Guest)
scenes.summary: The restaurant staff closely observes a well-dressed woman having lunch, anxiously wondering whether she is the feared food critic.

scenes.title: Гость Насти  (Nastya's Guest)
scenes.summary: Vika questions the floor staff about an unfamiliar visitor sitting in the dining room, learning that he is seated in Nastya's section.

scenes.title: Второй критик  (The Second Critic)
scenes.summary: Barinov questions waitress Nastya about a mysterious man who hasn't ordered anything and keeps writing notes, fearing there are now two critics.

scenes.title: Два критика  (Two Critics)
scenes.summary: When Victoria spots a suspicious man writing in a corner table, Chef Barinov is confounded by the possibility of having two reviewers in his restaurant at the same time.

scenes.title: Подача для критика  (Serving the Critic)
scenes.summary: Max carries an exquisite dish to the suspected reviewer while Victoria frantically doubts her earlier guess, telling Max to charm the patron with polite compliments.

scenes.title: Счастливый столик  (The Lucky Table)
scenes.summary: After a female guest rejects the restaurant's salad, an outraged Chef Barinov storms into the dining room to confront her despite Victoria's warnings against a scandal.

scenes.title: Тревога в зале  (Alarm in the Dining Room)
scenes.summary: Victoria and Chef Viktor panic when a female diner abruptly rushes to the restroom feeling nauseous, fearing a disaster with food poisoning.

scenes.title: Назойливый клиент  (The Pushy Customer)
scenes.summary: At a dining table, waitress Nastya takes an order from a rude customer suspected of being a secret critic, firmly rejecting his pushy attempts to flirt.

scenes.title: Неожиданное признание  (An Unexpected Confession)
scenes.summary: A male diner approaches Victoria to pay the bill and apologizes, explaining that his sick wife is pregnant with morning sickness and relieving the staff that she is not the critic.

scenes.title: Проблемный гость  (A Difficult Guest)
scenes.summary: At the bar, Nastya confides to Kostya that an influential restaurant critic is harassing her at table, urging Kostya not to provoke him with a confrontation.

scenes.title: Отказ от салата  (Rejecting the Salad)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Victoria urges Chef Viktor to give the complaining critic another customer's soup, but Viktor refuses to bypass ordinary guests.

scenes.title: Все равны  (Everyone Is Equal)
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Chef Viktor personally delivers the soup to an ordinary guest, boldly asserting to Victoria that all customers are equal in his kitchen.

scenes.title: Мудрый совет  (Wise Advice)
scenes.summary: At the bar, Kostya is troubled because an influential critic is harassing Nastya and he feels powerless to intervene. As the philosophical homeless regular Rodion savors his bowl of soup, he offers Kostya deep advice: whether the man is a critic or a janitor is beside the point—what matters is whether Kostya allows someone to disrespect his girlfriend.

scenes.title: Урок для критика  (A Lesson for the Critic)
scenes.summary: At the kitchen pass window, line cooks Senya and Fedya watch in astonishment as bartender Kostya boldly confronts the rude food critic in the dining room and defends Nastya, giving the arrogant patron a harsh lesson he will not forget.

scenes.title: Трус и увольнение  (The Coward and the Firing)
scenes.summary: Nastya apologizes to Kostya for insulting him, Chef Barinov abruptly fires the young bartender, and Vika nervously breaks the bad news to Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Отзыв критика  (The Critic's Review)
scenes.summary: Barinov's strict mother lectures him in the kitchen before the restaurant crew gathers around the TV to hear the food critic's glowing praise of Kostya.
